offering_description.value: CVR Partners makes and sells nitrogen fertilizers, primarily urea ammonium nitrate solution and ammonia, to agricultural distributors, retailers, and industrial buyers. It makes ammonia at plants in Kansas and Illinois and upgrades much of it into liquid fertilizer.

primary_products.value: urea ammonium nitrate solution; anhydrous ammonia

customer_segment.value: B2B: Agricultural fertilizer distributors and retailers, and industrial ammonia buyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: Bulk sales of liquid nitrogen fertilizer and ammonia

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Converts petroleum coke and natural gas into nitrogen products for agricultural distributors, retailers, and industrial buyers; asset operator: Runs two fertilizer plants that process feedstocks and load bulk products for agricultural and industrial customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Primarily the Midwest and Great Plains, with plants in Kansas and Illinois

specialization.value: related lines: Liquid nitrogen fertilizer and ammonia for agricultural and industrial use

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Bulk sales to fertilizer distributors, agricultural retailers, and industrial customers; distributors / dealers: Agricultural wholesalers and dealers that supply growers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA emissions and chemical accident prevention rules, OSHA process safety standards, and federal hazardous materials transport rules
